mentions.name: SOVEREIGN
mentions.description: SOVEREIGN is an initiative proposing a better way for the internet, set out in a founding document hosted on the author's site with accompanying GitHub pages. It frames the current internet as dominated by a few who profit off everyone else and invites others to get involved and help build the alternative.
mentions.problem: The author believes the internet is broken, enriched by and serving a few at the expense of everyone else, and argues there is a better way.
mentions.audience: People who are bothered by the current state of the internet, whom the author invites to reach out, get involved, and help build it
mentions.source_excerpt: When I realised There Is A Better Way *SOVEREIGN* Please read my founding document and have a mosey around my site and github pages.  https://at1c.com/AT1C_Founding_Document.html                      If this is something that bothers you as well please reach out get involved and help build this for humanity.
mentions.author: At1C
